title: The town pistachios built
text: The Wonderful Company, a major employer in Lost Hills, grew between 15 and 20 percent of the pistachio crop of the United States as of 2024, with most of it sold to China. Paramount Farms, which the same owners set up in 1989 to grow pistachios and almonds, built a new park and housing development in Lost Hills in the early 2000s.
